name: Surveyor's Eye
description: Silhouetted hexes display their step cost and any hazard flag before entry.

name: Deploy Waystation
description: A pocket rest on this hex — one use of a quarter-heal and +3 Essence — and a supply anchor while it stands. Expires with the expedition.

name: Clockwork Skimmer
description: Launch a gadget to any tile within 5; it charts radius 2 around its landing point.

name: Fulminant Charge
description: Rig the current hex: the first patrol to enter is stunned for 4 party steps.
